children.translated_text: ) The Blessed One said: 'Wicked speech is the sharpened weapon; passion (<s>rāga</s>) is <s>hālāhala</s> poison; hatred (<s>dveṣa</s>) is the blazing fire; ignorance (<s>avidyā</s>) is that terrible darkness.' || 2 || The deity

children.translated_text: ) 'What is seized by a mortal? And what is that which is abandoned here?

children.text: abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ kiṃ nu kiṃ vā tīkṣṇam ihāyudhaṃ / 3
children.translated_text: What is the impenetrable armor? And what is the sharp weapon here?' || 3 ||

children.text:
bhagavān āha /
  gṛhītaṃ yat svayaṃ dattaṃ yad gṛhe tad iho
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'What is seized is what was given by oneself; what is [left] in the house is abandoned

children.text: abhedyaṃ kavacaṃ kṣānti prajñā tīkṣṇam ihāyudham / 4
children.translated_text: 'Patience (<s>kṣānti</s>) is the impenetrable armor; wisdom (<s>prajñā</s>) is the sharp weapon here.' || 4 ||

children.text:
devatā prāha /
  ko nv asau procyate cauro dhanaṃ kiṃ vā satāṃ mataṃ /
  ke vā sadevake loke pro
children.translated_text: The deity said: 'Who indeed is called a thief? What is the wealth approved by the good? Who in the world with its gods are

children.text:
)
bhagavān āha /
  vitarkaḥ kuśalaś cauro dhanaṃ śīlaṃ satāṃ mataṃ /
  te cāpi muṣitā loke yaiḥ śīlaṃ vinipātitam / 6 (
children.translated_text: ) The Blessed One said: 'Discursive thought (<s>vitarka</s>) is the skilled thief; moral conduct (<s>śīla</s>) is the wealth approved by the good; and they in the world are robbed by whom moral conduct has been cast down.' || 6 || (

children.text:
)
devatā prāha /
  ko nv asau sukhito jñeya ko vā yaḥ parameśvaraḥ
  ko vā vibhūṣito nityaṃ brūhi ko vā viḍaṃbitaḥ 7
bhagavān āha / (
children.translated_text: ) The deity said: 'Who indeed is to be known as happy? Who is the supreme lord? Who is always adorned? Tell me, who is disgraced?' || 7 || The Blessed One said: (

children.text:
)
  alpecchaḥ sukhito jñeyaḥ saṃtuṣṭo parameśvaraḥ
  śīlavāṃ vibhūṣito nityaṃ bhraṣṭaśīlo viḍaṃbitaḥ 8
devatā prāha /
  kiṃ svid agnir na dahati na bhi
children.translated_text: ) 'One of few desires (<s>alpeccha</s>) is to be known as happy; one who is content (<s>saṃtuṣṭa</s>) is the supreme lord; the virtuous one (<s>śīlavat</s>) is always adorned; one whose morality has fallen is disgraced.' || 8 || The deity said: 'What is it that fire does not burn, nor does the wind

children.text: kiṃ svin na kledayanty āpaḥ plāvayanto vasundharām / 9
children.translated_text: nor do the waters soak, even when they flood the earth?' || 9 ||

children.text:
bhagavān āha /
  puṇyam agnir na dahati na bhinatti ca mārutaḥ
  puṇyaṃ na kledayan
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Merit (<s>puṇya</s>) fire does not burn, nor does the wind split; merit the waters do not
even when they flood the earth.' || 10 || (

children.text:
)
devatā prāha /
  kiṃ svid rājā ca caurāś ca spandamānā samudyatā /
  nāpahartuṃ śaknuvanti striyā vā puruṣa
children.translated_text: ) The deity said: 'What can kings and thieves, though straining and striving, not steal
) The Blessed One said: 'Merit (<s>puṇya</s>) — kings and thieves, though straining and striving,

children.text: nāpahartuṃ śaknuvanti striyā vā puruṣasya vā / 12
children.translated_text: cannot steal from a woman or a man.' || 12 ||
The deity said: 'Who is that affectionate

children.text: vaḥ ko 'sau ko vā duṣṭāśayo ripuḥ (
children.translated_text: man? And who is the enemy of evil intent? (

children.text: kiṃ vā tad dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ kiṃ vā paramaṃ sukham / 13
children.translated_text: What is that terrible suffering? And what is the supreme happiness?' || 13 ||

children.text:
bhagavān āha /
  vatsalo bāndhavaḥ puṇyaṃ pāpaṃ duṣṭāśayo ri
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Merit (<s>puṇya</s>) is the affectionate kinsman; sin (<s>pāpa</s>) is the enemy of evil

children.text: nārakaṃ dāruṇaṃ duḥkhaṃ śuddhā bhāvaḥ paramaṃ sukham / 14
children.translated_text: Hellish [suffering] is terrible suffering; pure disposition is the supreme happiness.' || 14 ||

children.text:
devatā prāha /
  kenāyam āvṛto lokaḥ kena loko vaśīkṛtaḥ
  kena tyajati mitrāṇi
children.translated_text: The deity said: 'By what is this world covered? By what is the world controlled? By what does one abandon friends?
what does one not go to heaven?' || 15 || (

children.text:
)
bhagavān āha /
  ajñānenāvṛto loko mohena ca vaśīkṛtaḥ
  lobhāt tyajati mitrāṇi saṃgāt svargaṃ na gaccha
children.translated_text: ) The Blessed One said: 'By ignorance (<s>ajñāna</s>) the world is covered; by delusion (<s>moha</s>) the world is controlled; through greed (<s>lobha</s>) one abandons friends; through attachment (<s>saṅga</s>) one does not go to
) The deity said: 'What is that which is pleasant but unwholesome? And what is wholesome but not pleasant?

children.text: ko vā pīḍākaro vyādhiḥ ko 'sāv eko bhiṣag varaḥ / 17
children.translated_text: What is the disease that causes affliction? And who is that one supreme physician?' || 17 ||

children.text: māḥ priyā apathyāś ca mokṣaḥ pathyo na ca priyaḥ (
children.translated_text: sires (<s>kāma</s>) are pleasant but unwholesome; liberation (<s>mokṣa</s>) is wholesome but not pleasant. (

children.text: rāgaḥ pīḍākaro vyādhir buddhaś caiko bhiṣag varaḥ / 18
children.translated_text: Passion (<s>rāga</s>) is the disease that causes affliction; the <s>Buddha</s> is the one supreme physician.' || 18 ||

children.text:
devatā prāha /
  kena mitrāṇi vardhante ke
children.translated_text: The deity said: 'By what do friends increase? By

children.text: kena svargam avāpnoti kena mokṣaṃ ca gacchati / 19
children.translated_text: By what does one attain heaven? By what does one attain liberation (<s>mokṣa</s>)?' || 19 ||

children.text:
bhagavān āha /
  tyāgān mitrāṇi vardhante maitryā śāmyanti śatravaḥ
  śīlā
children.translated_text: The Blessed One said: 'Through generosity (<s>tyāga</s>), friends increase; through loving-kindness (<s>maitrī</s>), enemies are pacified; through moral

children.text: svargam avāpnoti jñānān mokṣaṃ ca gacchati / 20 (
children.translated_text: one attains heaven, and through knowledge one also reaches liberation. (verse 20)

children.text:
)
devatā prāha /
  idaṃ saṃśayam adyāpi mama tvaṃ chettum arhasi /
  asmāl lokā
children.translated_text: The deity said: "This doubt of mine — you should today cut it asunder. From this world,
next world — who has gone utterly deceived?" (verse 21)
The Blessed One said: "One who, when enjoyments are available, has not accumulated merit —

children.text: asmāl lokāt paraṃ lokaṃ so gato 'tyantavaṃcitaḥ / 22
children.translated_text: from this world to the next world, that one has gone utterly deceived." (verse 22)
"After a long time, indeed, I see a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who has attained <s>parinirvṛti</s> (complete liberation),
who has gone beyond all enmity and fear, who has crossed over attachment in the world." (verse 23)

children.translated_text: having rejoiced in and approved of, bowing with her head at the Blessed One's feet, departed from the Blessed One's presence.
Thus was heard by me. At one time the Blessed One (<s>Bhagavān</s>) was dwelling in <s>Śrāvastī</s> (

children.translated_text: the entire <s>Jetavana</s> was illuminated with an extraordinary brilliance. Seated to one side, that deity at that moment spoke a verse:
Thus have I heard. At one time, the Blessed One was dwelling in <s>Śrā-</s>

children.text: lāḥ kiṃsamācārāḥ ke guṇāḥ kena karmaṇā / (
children.translated_text: duct? Of what practice? What virtues? By what action?
What wise ones ... which people are heaven-bound?" (verse 1) The Teacher answered the deity:

children.text:
)
  śrūyatāṃ devate mahyaṃ ye janā svargagāminaḥ 2
  prāṇātipātād viratā suśīlāḥ saṃyame ratāḥ
  yena hiṃsanti bhūtāni te janāḥ svargagāminaḥ 3
children.translated_text: "Listen to me, O deity, which people are heaven-bound: (verse 2) Those who abstain from taking life, of good conduct, delighting in restraint — by which they do not harm beings — those people are heaven-bound." (verse 3)
